name: Desvenlafaxine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: A large fraction is excreted unchanged in urine. The metabolized fraction mainly undergoes UGT conjugation; CYP3A4 contributes minor N-demethylation. CYP2D6 is not part of its metabolic pathway.
